title: Delta File
description: Per-run snapshot of what changed in a single scraper run. Lives at output/deltas/<timestamp>_<source>.json. See docs/JOB_SCHEMA.md for full documentation.

run_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the scraper run that produced this delta.

source.description: Source label (same values as the ats field on job records).

added.description: Jobs newly added to all_jobs.json this run (got a new first_seen timestamp). Each entry is a full job record.

updated.description: Existing jobs that were enriched this run (gained description, salary, or other backfilled fields). Each entry is the full updated job record.
